product.name: Boombah Ink Custom Volleyball Uniforms
product.description: Design Custom Boombah Volleyball Uniforms. Choose from short sleeve, sleeveless, shorts and warm up shirts to suit your teams needs. With the bold and vibrant designs, these fully sublimated uniforms will make a statement on the court. Orders having less than 10 garments are subject to a minimum order fee of $25.
product.leadTime: Mockup Lead Time: 2-4 business days after order is placed. Ships: 2 weeks after artwork approval.
